# ------------------------
# 2. Mean geographic center (centroid of coords)
# ------------------------
mean_center <- data.frame(
  X = mean(st_coordinates(deaths_loc)[,1]),
  Y = mean(st_coordinates(deaths_loc)[,2])
) %>% st_as_sf(coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = st_crs(deaths_loc))
Code 
# ------------------------
# 3. Weighted mean geographic center
# ------------------------
weighted_center <- data.frame(
  X = weighted.mean(st_coordinates(deaths_loc)[,1], deaths_loc$deaths),
  Y = weighted.mean(st_coordinates(deaths_loc)[,2], deaths_loc$deaths)
) %>% st_as_sf(coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = st_crs(deaths_loc))
Code

# 4. Median geographic center (component-wise median)
# ------------------------
median_center <- data.frame(
  X = median(st_coordinates(deaths_loc)[,1]),
  Y = median(st_coordinates(deaths_loc)[,2])
) %>% st_as_sf(coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = st_crs(deaths_loc))

  Y = Median(st_coordinates(deaths_loc)[,2], w = deaths_loc$deaths)
) %>% st_as_sf(coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = st_crs(deaths_loc))

Code 
# manual way
# formula: sqrt( sum(wi*((xi-x̄)^2 + (yi-ȳ)^2)) / sum(wi) )
  mean_X = weighted.mean(st_coordinates(deaths_loc)[,1], deaths_loc$deaths)
  mean_Y = weighted.mean(st_coordinates(deaths_loc)[,2], deaths_loc$deaths)

sdist <- sqrt(
  sum(deaths_loc$deaths * ((st_coordinates(deaths_loc)[,1] - mean_X)^2 + (st_coordinates(deaths_loc)[,2] - mean_Y)^2)) / sum(deaths_loc$deaths)
)

# Circle around weighted mean center
circle_coords <- function(center, r, n=100){
  angles <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out=n)
  x <- center[1] + r*cos(angles)
  y <- center[2] + r*sin(angles)
  data.frame(X=x, Y=y)
}

circle_df <- circle_coords(c(mean_X, mean_Y), sdist) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("X","Y"), crs=st_crs(deaths_loc)) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_combine(geometry)) %>%
  st_cast("POLYGON")
Code 
# Convert coords to matrix
X <- cbind(st_coordinates(deaths_loc)[,1], st_coordinates(deaths_loc)[,2])

# Weighted covariance
cov_w <- cov.wt(X, wt=deaths_loc$deaths)$cov

# Eigen decomposition (axes of ellipse)
eig <- eigen(cov_w)
radii <- sqrt(eig$values) * 2  # scale factor for 1 SD ellipse

theta <- seq(0, 2*pi, length=200)
ellipse <- t(t(eig$vectors %*% diag(radii)) %*% rbind(cos(theta), sin(theta)))
ellipse <- sweep(ellipse, 2, c(mean_X, mean_Y), FUN="+")

ellipse_df <- data.frame(X=ellipse[,1], Y=ellipse[,2]) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords=c("X","Y"), crs=st_crs(deaths_loc)) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_combine(geometry)) %>%
  st_cast("POLYGON")
Code 
# 8. Plotting results
# ------------------------
p<- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = deaths_loc, aes(size = deaths), color="blue", alpha=0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = mean_center, color="red", size=3, shape=17) +
  geom_sf(data = weighted_center, color="darkgreen", size=3, shape=15) +
  geom_sf(data = median_center, color="purple", size=3, shape=3) +
  geom_sf(data = weighted_median_center, color="orange", size=3, shape=8) +
  geom_sf(data = circle_df, fill=NA, color="black", linetype="dashed") +
  geom_sf(data = ellipse_df, fill=NA, color="brown", linetype="solid") +
  labs(title="Geographic Descriptive Statistics",
       subtitle="Centers, Standard Distance, and Standard Deviational Ellipse",
       x="Longitude", y="Latitude") +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_sf(datum = st_crs(deaths_loc))

ggplotly(p)
